_meta.description: First-party measurement configuration and launch-evidence checklist. This is not visitor data or an authorized Amazon report.
_meta.rule: Collection is disabled. A nonempty URL alone cannot enable it: every launch check needs a dated evidence reference and reviewer. Local tests never become campaign-ledger rows.

retention_status: Staged maximum: 30 UTC day buckets, including today. Pruned on writes, startup and hourly while the reference collector runs. Backups and host logs require a separate reviewed deletion policy before launch.

events.name: page_view
events.payload: Known canonical page path only; no query string or fragment

events.name: outbound_click
events.when: A trusted left, keyboard or middle click on a sponsored, tagged link to a registered product
events.payload: Known page path and catalog ASIN; never the affiliate URL
events.aggregate: Separate daily counts per path and per ASIN; not unique visitors or Amazon-reported clicks

events.name: guide_read_75
events.when: The 75% marker in a published guide or article becomes visible, at most once per eligible page load
events.payload: Known guide or article path only
events.aggregate: Daily count per guide; a visibility milestone, not proof of reading

events.name: category_click
events.when: A trusted click on a published category link
events.payload: Known source page path and allowlisted category path only
events.aggregate: Separate daily counts per source page and target category

events.name: feed_click
events.when: A trusted click on this site's RSS feed link
events.aggregate: Daily count per path; not a subscription count

launch_checks.question: Does the selected host permit this commercial affiliate publication?
launch_checks.known: GitHub Pages is static hosting. Its usage limits exclude running an online business or a site primarily facilitating commercial transactions as a free hosting service. A deployed preview is not evidence that this use is permitted.
launch_checks.missing: Written hosting-use clearance or a suitable commercial host and canonical-site migration plan.
launch_checks.discovery: Review the host's terms for the intended use; obtain written clarification or select permitted hosting. Keep one canonical site when migrating, including sitemap, feed and redirects.

launch_checks.question: Is there a durable HTTPS collector with reviewed production protections?
launch_checks.known: The reference Python collector is testable locally; Python explicitly does not recommend http.server for production. GitHub Pages cannot run this backend.
launch_checks.missing: Production runtime, HTTPS URL, approved origin, request limits, access control for count exports, and operational review.
launch_checks.discovery: Deploy an appropriately secured service on permitted hosting; review TLS termination, timeouts, request/body limits, storage permissions and operator access. Do not expose the reference server directly to the internet.
launch_checks.source_label: Python's http.server documentation and production warning

launch_checks.question: Are privacy, consent and every layer of request logging reviewed?
launch_checks.known: The client omits credentials and Referer, honors DNT/GPC, and sends bounded fields. The collector stores aggregates without visitor identifiers. Hosting and network services still receive connection metadata; GitHub documents security IP logging for Pages.
launch_checks.missing: Controller identity, visitor-facing privacy terms, applicable consent decision, and host/CDN/proxy log handling.
launch_checks.discovery: Document the actual provider, purpose, access, location and retention of host logs; review applicable privacy/consent duties. Inspect a staging request and every logging layer rather than describing the whole service as anonymous.

launch_checks.question: Can retained aggregates, backups and logs actually be deleted on schedule?
launch_checks.known: The staged collector limits its own aggregate file to 30 UTC day buckets. It prunes at startup, on writes and hourly while running; --prune-only supports an independent scheduled cleanup.
launch_checks.missing: Accepted retention period and evidence of scheduled cleanup, stopped-service cleanup, backup expiry and restricted count-file access on the chosen host.
launch_checks.discovery: Use an isolated dated fixture to prove cutoff and deletion, then configure and document the host's schedule and backup/log expiry. Never commit counts or test fixtures as real campaign data.

launch_checks.question: Do the deployed browser and collector agree on the five events?
launch_checks.known: Automated tests exercise the generated client and a temporary local collector. They are not production traffic, Amazon reporting evidence or completed Associates tests.
launch_checks.missing: Dated deployment acceptance record for the permitted origin, five payloads, privacy opt-outs, error behavior and aggregate export.
launch_checks.discovery: Run the contract checks against isolated staging counts with outbound destinations intercepted, never by generating Amazon affiliate clicks. Confirm opt-outs send nothing; reject foreign origins and unknown fields. Keep staging counts out of production and the campaign ledger.

source_reads.scope: Usage limits, not a determination by GitHub about this particular site.
Static hosting and Pages security IP logging.
Transport referrer policy; the client never reads document.referrer.
Best-effort analytics delivery across page unload.
Production warning; no assertion that the reference collector is production ready.
